messages: maya: dropped a new compact-playground mock that groups the token pill, prompt library chevron, and action cluster. attached. thinking about keyboard affordances + how handoff to prompt library should behave. quick thoughts? design-bot: uploaded image compact-handoff-v1.png :framed_picture: sam: quick eng notes: - current token counter updates every 200ms. that'll cause repaints in this tight header; suggest throttle to 1s and clamp width. - adding a keyboard shortcut to stop (Ctrl+/) is fine but we'll need a small global handler and to avoid clashes. emily: copy first-pass: - primary action: 'Interrupt' still my fave for clarity. - alternate microcopy idea: use 'Handoff' as a discoverable action that opens the prompt library with the selected text. - token pill microcopy: 'Tokens: 1,234' for compactness; tooltip: 'Tokens used in this conversation'. liam: accessibility pointers: - stream output should be aria-live="polite" and throttled; don't spam SRs. - visual token pill aria-hidden="true" plus separate sr-only announcer updated on completion/milestones (eg every 100 tokens). - keyboard shortcut should be visible in the tooltip and documented in keyboard help. ensure focus order doesn't change when prompt chevron opens the library. ara: UX thought on handoff: - clicking the chevron should open a small drawer anchored to the prompt that previews library templates. allow quick insert without losing current prompt. - if user triggers handoff via shortcut, focus should land in the library search field. offer an escape to return focus to the composer. maya: decisions proposal: - label: 'Interrupt' for stop action; keep semantics abortive (not resumable). - token pill visible but debounced to 1s, fixed width, aria-hidden=true. sr-announcer updates on completion and 100-token milestones. - chevron opens prompt library drawer; keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+/) opens the drawer and focuses search. - preserve partial output during regenerate and overlay a subtle spinner. sam: implementation checklist for PR: - debounce token updates to 1s and clamp width. - add Ctrl+/ handler to open prompt drawer (only when composer focused). - implement visual token pill aria-hidden + sr-only announcer snippet. - preserve partial output on regenerate with spinner overlay. emily: i18n keys i'll add: - playground.stream.action_interrupt = "Interrupt" - playground.stream.tokens_compact = "Tokens: {n}" - playground.prompt.handoff_hint = "Open prompt library (Ctrl+/)" liam: a11y QA steps i'll add: - confirm aria-live polite throttling behaviour with VoiceOver/NVDA - sr-announcer updates only on completion/milestones - keyboard shortcut discoverability and focus return - color contrast for pill and chevron maya: sounds good. I'll update the mock to show the chevron label and a tiny hint under the pill for new users: 'Tokens shown for transparency' (visually small, sr-only hidden). posting v1a soon. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded image compact-handoff-v1a.png :framed_picture: sam: i'll open the PR with the token debounce + sr snippet and tag you all. snippet for review: ```html Tokens: 1,234 Tokens used: 1234 ``` emily: adding copy + tooltip strings to i18n branch. liam: QA checklist ready, will loop in accessibility reviewers. maya: closing this thread for the design iteration. reopen if anything diverges during the PR.
